verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Floot exposes a remote MCP server that AI chat clients and editors (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) can drive interactively. Nothing documents a CLI, a headless mode, an API token flow for CI pipelines, or any CI integration, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. MCP use from an interactive AI client and scheduled jobs inside built apps are adjacent features, not headless or CI operation of the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
